items.title: Crude oil, West Asia situation likely to drive stock market this week
items.description: Investors will track crude prices, global bond yields, FPI activity and implications of the US law allowing tariffs on buyers of Russian oil and gas

items.title: 6 companies line up IPOs worth ₹3,825 cr amid brisk primary market activity
items.description: The IPOs will be available for public subscription between September 22 and September 28, with most of the issues opening on September 23

items.title: FPIs withdraw ₹20,974 crore from equities in Sep amid global uncertainty
items.description: The latest outflow comes after foreign investors returned to Indian equities in July and August, when they invested ₹20,200 crore and ₹29,630 crore, respectively, according to data from CDSL
